claims.text: The FDA label flags possible CNS depression when lasmiditan is combined with alcohol.
claims.quote: REYVOW may cause CNS depression and should be used with caution if used in combination with alcohol or other CNS depressants.

claims.text: The FDA label says concomitant lasmiditan and alcohol administration has not been evaluated in clinical studies.
claims.quote: Concomitant administration of REYVOW and alcohol or other CNS depressant drugs has not been evaluated in clinical studies.

headline.text: The FDA label flags CNS depression with lasmiditan and alcohol; clinical combination studies have not been evaluated.

reported.text: The FDA label describes an unevaluated combination rather than a measured clinical interaction.

gaps.text: The packet contains no PubMed abstract evaluating this combination.
